paper.title: Continuum neural wavefunctions for anyons on a torus: superfluidity in the semion gas

results.system_description: 2 identical continuum semions of mass m on a two-dimensional unit square torus Lx=Ly=1; exchange phase +i (alpha=1/2); H=kappa sum_i D_i^2, kappa=hbar^2/(2m), D_i=-i grad_i+A_i the statistical covariant derivative; no additional scalar interaction or external field; regular Friedrichs collision domain. Two-component torus transport of Sec. II, beta_x=beta_y=0. Total energy includes center-of-mass motion.
results.variant: learned two-orbital frame; width 64; train P_2, evaluate finite momentum filter P_4
results.source_location: Table 1, N=2; Secs. II, III and V; Supplement S9
results.eligibility_evidence: Original neural variational state, evaluated by the positive kinetic-energy form in a separate frozen-parameter VMC run with a new random stream (Supplement S9). The finite translation filter explicitly represents a variational state, not an imaginary-time projection estimate.
results.notes: 2048 walkers; 4000 frozen measurements, ten sweeps per measurement. Parentheses are one blocked standard error; largest blocked error retaining at least 32 blocks. Finite P_g is not exact zero-momentum projection; residual COM energy is retained. No mean-field, ED, or density-scaled duplicate entered. N=2 energy is above exact 13.673332280. Version v2 supersedes requested backfill v1.
